name: PBT Spec & Invariant Guard
description: Automatically runs the 300-vector Property-Based Testing suite and verifies EARS spec round-trip invariants whenever a spec or core module is saved.

action.prompt: Run `node tests/chimera.pbt.test.js`. If any EARS clause is marked AMBIGUOUS_SPEC or any PBT property fails, shrink the counterexample and propose a spec-compliant fix before allowing commit.
